description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f 09.06.2025 to 15.06.2025
categorisation: This gazette content announces the determination of customs exchange rates under the Customs Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for customs duties and charges. It falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
